description: Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge - Execute commands based on player's active playtime

mods.name: PlayTimeRewards
mods.description: A server-side Forge mod that rewards players with configurable items and commands based on playtime.

releases.notes:
# Changelog

All notable changes to PlayTimeRewards are documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [1.0.0] - 2026-08-26

### Added

- Initial release for Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge 47+
- Server-side playtime tracking with per-world persistence
- Configurable one-time milestone rewards and repeating rewards
- Item rewards with optional NBT, including random-item selection
- Console command rewards with `{player}` substitution and random-command selection
- Pending reward queue when a player's inventory is full (`/rewards claim`)
- Optional AFK detection that pauses playtime
- Configurable broadcast and player messages with `&` color codes
- Commands: `/rewards`, `/rewards claim`, `/rewards check`, `/rewards reload`, `/rewards reset`
- Default starter, hourly, and veteran reward tiers generated on first launch

[1.0.0]: https://github.com/Flurben/PlayTimeRewards/releases/tag/v1.0.0
